answer: Each identity must tend a terrace, a stepped garden of small plots of real work. Honest terraces hold many plants; a farm's are one crop, planted the same hour. Every identity carries a plume, a feather earned by a deed. Honest plumes are many colors, earned one by one; a farm's are all the same dye, dipped at once. Trust flows like nectar, gathered slowly from many flowers. Honest nectar comes from a hundred flowers; a farm's from one jar. To pass, a farm must build a real terrace, earn a real plume, and gather real nectar for every sockpuppet.
